messages:
emily (docs): Hey team, opening a tiny PR to harmonize region wording across all localized pages and to add deployment-mode columns. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912 :memo:
ryan (eng): 👍 Can you also surface the per-region endpoint hostnames and which regions currently support hosted KMS wrapping?
pablo (i18n): Also we need to think about translations: the German and French pages currently translate 'data locality' inconsistently. Want to coordinate with translators before merging.
noor (legal): Important: use the approved public line verbatim: "We may process or store customer data in the geographic region selected for your tenancy. Contractual data locality guarantees are available via enterprise agreements." Don't promise contractual terms in localized pages unless Sales signs off.
emily (docs): Copying Noor's sentence verbatim into the PR. @pablo can you add recommended localized phrasing in comments (DE/FR/JA)?
pablo (i18n): Will add. Suggestion: DE: "Datenlokalität" (avoid direct "Residency" translation). FR: "localisation des données" is fine. I'll paste exact strings in PR review.
ryan (eng): Hosted endpoints: us-west-2 -> api.us.redwood.ai, eu-west-1 -> api.eu.redwood.ai, ap-northeast-1 -> api.ap.redwood.ai. KMS wrapping hosted: us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. ap-southeast-1 dedicated = beta.
emily (docs): Thanks. Plan in PR: table columns = region | endpoint | hosted | dedicated | private (VPC/on-prem) | kms | notes; add Node + Python SDK snippets showing region param; add a tiny translation note and DPA footnote for EU-DE.
pablo (i18n): For the translator handoff: add a comment block with the exact string and context. Translators need to know this is legal-sensitive. I'll request expedited review for DE/FR.
noor (legal): Also add Sales contact template for customers who want contractual locality. I'll paste approved one-liner in the PR review.
emily (docs): Will do. Also fixing two stale links in the region page (broken link to /docs/compliance and a bad anchor to performance). If reviewers are quick I'll merge after i18n + legal sign-off.
ops-bot: Reminder  docs CI will run on push and i18n folks should link translations in PR metadata.
emily (docs): Pushed the branch. Tagging @pablo for translations and @noor for legal sign-off. Resolving thread unless blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
